lines: וְאִם יוֹם אֶחָד נְכַחֵשׁ וְיִקְרָא הַתַּרְנְגֹל

review: The hymn is the God of the fathers: 1:1–8 is Deut 7:9 with Ps 78:15–16 and Dan 6:23 and 1 Sam 17:45–47, the chorus is Ps 106:1 with Lam 3:22–23 and Exod 15:11, 2:1–8 is Acts 16:26 with Exod 14:21–22 and Dan 3:25, and 3:1–8 is Exod 3:15 with Ps 103:4 and Luke 22:61 (the crowing cock).

The dialect forms of the print are rendered in elevated Hebrew without flattening the specific references: אֱלֹהֵי דָנִיֵּאל, גָּלְיָת, כִּבְשַׁן הָאֵשׁ and קְרִיאַת הַתַּרְנְגֹל all keep their biblical names.

1:8 מֵחֶרֶב גָּלְיָת וּמִגּוּב הָאֲרָיוֹת keeps the two deliverances as one line, as the print pairs سِيف جُلْيَات with جُبّ أُسُود; the Hebrew uses גּוּב (the pit of Jer 14:10's cognate and Dan 6's בּוֹר) because the line needs the lions' den and not a general 'danger'.
